messages:
oncall-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT ALERT — routing-policy runtime exception detected (policy-service)
oncall-bot: Incident ID: INC-1945-6789 | Severity: P2 | Affected: smart-routing -> model-variant selection | Initial detections: 1945126789
elena: I got the page. pulling logs now — can someone confirm customer-facing errors? @customer-success-bot any reports?
customer-success-bot: 2 active support threads mentioning slow responses and 503s in us-west. customers: acme-corp, finlytics. forwarding links.
carlos: seeing repeated reevaluation loops in routing logs. stacktrace shows panic during expression compile in policy engine.
opsbot: snippet from policy-service stderr:
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
goroutine 142 [running]:
policy/eval.(*Expression).Eval(0xc0003b8000, 0xc00012b0a0, 0xc0000e4000)
	/go/src/policy/eval/expression.go:238 +0x1b2
policy/engine.(*Policy).Evaluate(0xc0000f8000, 0xc00012b0a0, 0xc00008a000)
	/go/src/policy/engine/engine.go:412 +0x3f
```
opsbot: same trace repeated every ~300ms, correlated with increased 503s from inference-gateway.
sasha: is this hitting only one policy or a set? need policy id and recent deploys.
elena: policy-id: prd-smart-route-435. last config change 6h ago by manuel (rolling config update for region fallback).
carlos: reproducer: `curl -X POST https://policy-service/ev -d '{"request": {"region":"us-west-2","model":"m-3b-q"}}'` -> policy engine crashes.
sasha: urgent mitigation: disable evaluation for that policy (fall back to default static route) until we patch. can someone run the disable? I'll coordinate rollout.
elena: on it. running:
```
redwoodctl policy set-priority prd-smart-route-435 --priority=0 --disable-eval
```
elena: API responded 202 accepted. verifying routing table.
carlos: routing table shows immediate failover to default-route (model m-3b-stable in us-west-2). request latencies back to normal for test traffic.
customer-success-bot: alerted acme-corp with a brief note. response: they saw degradation ~5m, now improved. they requested ETA for fix.
sasha: root cause hypothesis: malformed expression in the new fallback expression allowed a nil path (manual review flagged a ternary that didn't guard nil). will triage in main thread. need a hotfix to the expression compiler to guard nils.
elena: on-call handoff scheduled: @carlos will take next 2 hours, @elena will remain available for escalations. tagging incident channel with owner INC-1945-6789.
carlos: building a small patch to short-circuit nils in expr eval. test locally then can promote to canary.
opsbot: creating rollback/change ticket: CHG-2911, linking to incident.
sasha: timeline notes: detection 1945126789, mitigation (disable policy) 1945126950, customer notice 1945126980. please add timestamps to the incident page.
elena: thanks everyone. next steps: carlos to push hotfix to canary in 15m, sasha to review policy expression, ops to prepare a postmortem template. I'll update infra channel if anything changes. :thumbsup:
